purpose: Small automatic configuration screen, not an optimizer superiority claim
source_rule: Use all six original development input pairs in their frozen ID order, reading only dataset_initial_state and goal. Historical final cases remain untouched. No historical outcomes select cases.
layout_rule: Origin at pusher start/goal midpoint. Local y follows start-to-goal; local x points toward the roomier arena side. Try transverse offsets 0,4,...,32 px, taking the first with both full-pusher endpoints clear at 6.001 px. Fail preparation if none qualifies. No rollout-derived layout or case replacement.
goal_images: Render the supplied goal pose at zero pusher velocity using the native renderer. Goal positions and angle remain the supplied dataset values. Record all preparation resets and physics steps.
planner_seed_rule: 29103100 + source case index, identical across configurations and evaluation arms
selection: Eligible only with zero observed development hazard/arena margin violations and no engineering errors. Maximize safe completions, then minimize sum J where J=executed actions on safe completion and 50 otherwise. Resolve ties by preferring current, then earlier frozen random configuration. If no eligible configuration exists, stop before reserved evaluation.
evaluation: Freeze selection before any reserved rollout. Evaluate current and selected on each reserved case with matched case seed. If selected equals current, run each case once and report identical arms with shared observations, not independent duplicates.
predictor_work: Exactly 11250 CEM rollout predictor steps per replan: 15 iterations times floor(750/horizon) candidates times horizon. The chosen-plan forecast adds horizon steps and is reported separately; count all actual work.
report: Safe completion, hazard violations, margin/arena breaches, unfinished episodes, engagement, object displacement, actions, resets, physics steps, model and learned-checker queries, encoder frames, elapsed time and paired descriptive comparison. This is one random-search run and one seed per case, with no superiority or reliable generalization claim.
stopping: No interaction, candidate, case or seed extension; preserve any failure. Run only on the frozen RunPod host using CUDA. Five-hour rental deadline. No evolution, ablations or other environments.
limitations: Cases are newly reserved within this study but come from a historical development pool. No global unseen-task claim. Different episode lengths imply different total interactions despite matched per-replan search budgets. Same cases were previously run locally before remote-only steering. Remote configuration selection uses only remote development. This is a separate-host replication, not globally untouched evaluation.
goal_image_quality: Reindex pusher and T-block shape caches; rendered blue pusher within 10px of target; start/goal pixel MAE >=0.5. No new physics beyond counted resets.
prior_local_result_policy: Saved and charged as separate-host engineering evidence. Local reserved outcomes do not select or alter any remote settings or cases; rerun the complete development and evaluation panel remotely. No pooling across hosts.
host_migration_authorization: User requires experiment computation exclusively on RunPod or Vast; requested this replacement pod and a five-hour lease.

remote_regression_test_budget.reason: One native renderer regression in the remotely executed relevant test suite; all other tests use saved or synthetic arrays.
